mechanism: FeedForward MLP takes a rolling HistoryBars window of 12 features per bar (Close-Open, High-Open, Low-Open, tick volume/1000, month, hour, day-of-week, RSI, CCI, ATR, MACD main+signal). Labels are Bill-Williams-style fractals on the prior bar (buy/sell/none) via High/Low 3-bar peaks; regression (1 out) or 3-way classification; online backProp after each new bar. Senses impending pivot before the third confirming candle.
data_needed: OHLCV + RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD buffers; fractal labels from High/Low; optional saved .nnw weights
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; HistoryBars=20; StudyPeriod years of history (~12.4k bars / 2y test); PERIOD_CURRENT configurable
why_new_for_mis: Explicit pre-confirmation pivot/fractal probability sensor from mixed price-oscillator-calendar features, not a lagging fractal plot.
quote: What if we set the neural network to determine the pivot points before the third candlestick is formed? This approach would give at least one prior candlestick of movement in the trade direction.

mechanism: CNN inserts convolutional filters (window=step=12 = one-bar feature vector) that learn unstated candlestick/oscillator patterns, then subsample averages (window=3,step=2) to denoise and compress; feature maps feed the prior fractal classifier. Filters act as translation-tolerant pattern detectors on chart structure.
data_needed: Same 12-features×N bars as Part 2; trained convolution kernels
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 20 bars; 4 conv filters; compared vs fully-connected fractal EA
why_new_for_mis: Learned local pattern filters + pooling as a chart-regime/pattern front-end before a decision head—usable as a pattern presence sensor.
quote: When applied to trading, I want to use convolutional neural networks to improve the recognition of trading patterns on a price chart.

mechanism: Because no-fractal bars dominate (~60–70% model probability stuck on absence), training softens the no-signal target from 1.0 to 0.5 while buy/sell stay 0/1. On EURUSD H1 fractal task this cut miss rate ~100%→51% and raised hits to ~9.9%, with signals clustering into zones.
data_needed: Same fractal classification labels; tunable soft target for majority class
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 20 bars; learning rates 0.1/0.01/0.001 and decay schedule compared
why_new_for_mis: Rare-event sensing trick: soft majority-class targets to keep a neural detector from collapsing to always-no-signal.
quote: for the absence of a fractal in the reference value, I specified 0.5 instead of 1 when training the network.

mechanism: Self-Attention block (Query/Key/Value via upgraded conv layers, Score=softmax(QK/√d), residual+FF) over HistoryBars embedded candle vectors. Attention weights pairwise bar dependencies so the net focuses on trend/range-relevant bars rather than fixed windows; two encoder layers then dense head predict fractal class.
data_needed: Embedded per-bar feature sequence; OpenCL attention kernels
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 20 bars; embed window_out=36; Adam; ~25 epochs → ~35–36% error, 22–23% hit
why_new_for_mis: Sequence relevance sensor: which prior bars matter for the current state—maps to focusing MIS on influential history.
quote: When analyzing a candlestick symbol chart, we define trends and tendencies, as well as determine their trading ranges. It means, we select some objects from the general picture and focus our attention on them.

mechanism: Shows how to annotate NeuroNet.mqh/cl with Doxygen comments, groups, MathJax formulas and generate HTML/CHM docs. No market sensing algorithm.
why_new_for_mis: No sensing idea after full read—code documentation workflow only.
quote: The purpose of the documentation is to generalize all objects and methods in the library and to build a hierarchy of inheritance of objects and methods.

mechanism: Four parallel Self-Attention heads with distinct Wq/Wv, concatenate, project by W0; sinusoidal pos encoding added to input (sin even dims / cos odd dims of bar index) so distance between bars is explicit. Improves fractal classifier vs single-head under same EURUSD H1 setup (error ~0.25 vs ~0.37).
data_needed: Per-bar embeddings + position index; multi-head OpenCL kernels
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 20 bars; 2 MH-Attention layers; Adam; 20 epochs parallel vs Self-Attention
why_new_for_mis: Multi-viewpoint sequence sensor plus explicit temporal distance encoding for bar-order-sensitive regimes.
quote: The Multi-Head Attention architecture implies the parallel use of multiple self-attention threads having different weight, which imitates a versatile analysis of a situation.

mechanism: CNeuronDropoutOCL randomly zeros neurons with probability p during train (scale 1/q), bypasses layer at inference via buffer swap. Improves fractal EA convergence but is a training regularizer, not a market sensor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 20 bars; dropout p=0.2 at four places in GPT-like attention stack
why_new_for_mis: No new market sensing idea after full read—Dropout is co-adaptation prevention during training only.
quote: a group of scientists from the university of Toronto proposed to randomly exclude some of the neurons from the learning process as a solution to the complex co-adaptation problem

mechanism: CNeuronBatchNormOCL keeps per-neuron EMA mean/variance, normalizes to ~N(0,1), then learns γ,β; optional activation on the norm layer. Allows higher LR and lower fractal prediction error, but is internal covariate-shift control, not a market sensor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 20 bars; batch window=100; LR raised 1e-6→1e-3 vs Dropout EA
why_new_for_mis: No new market sensing idea after full read—BatchNorm is a training stabilizer only.
quote: The idea of the method is to normalize each individual neuron on a certain time interval with a shift in the median of the sample (batch) towards zero and to bring the sample variance to 1.

mechanism: Build vectors of 20 stacked bars × (Close-Open, High-Close, Close-Low, RSI, CCI, MACD/signal/hist); run sklearn KMeans for k=50..1000; choose k via elbow of mean within-cluster distance (~400–500 on 98,641 EURUSD H1 states). Unsupervised assignment of each window to a pattern/cluster ID without labeled fractals.
data_needed: H1 OHLCV + RSI/CCI/MACD; rolling 20-bar stacked feature matrix; k-means centers
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 2006-01-01→2022-01-01 (~16y); k 50–1000 step 50; TA-Lib oscillators
why_new_for_mis: Unsupervised regime/pattern codebook over multi-bar feature windows—cluster ID as a discrete market-state sensor without supervised labels.
quote: what if we use unsupervised data clustering algorithms to let the model identify all possible variations in the data over a certain time period.

mechanism: CNeuronFreDFOCL output loss: FFT (or transpose-then-FFT) of forecast and label sequences; MAE on complex freq coeffs; mix L = α L_freq + (1-α) L_time (α≈0.8); inverse FFT of freq gradients. Forces multi-step Direct Forecast to respect label autocorrelation in orthogonal freq bases. Applied to FEDformer encoder (NForecast=12) and Actor/Critic heads on EURUSD H1.
data_needed: Model multi-step forecast tensor + aligned target sequence; FFT buffers; α hyperparameter
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 2023; test Jan 2024; NForecast=12 bars; FEDformer + Actor-Critic
why_new_for_mis: Frequency-domain residual/alignment sensor for multi-horizon forecasts—penalizes spectral mismatch, not only pointwise time error.
quote: FreDF bypasses the effect of autocorrelation of target values by aligning the generated predicted values and the sequence of labels in the frequency domain.

mechanism: For each prior-year US NFP timestamp, compare EURUSD M15 candle height (High-Low) at event time vs ±1 hour; if the taller spike shifts relative to calendar time across the year, map ShiftStart/ShiftEnd onto AU/UK/US DST windows to auto-detect broker DST. Same spike test validates whether calendar event time matches realized volatility burst. Stores DST-adjusted economic calendar SQLite for tester use.
data_needed: MQL5 CalendarValueHistory (NFP event_id 840030016); EURUSD M15 OHLC; DST schedule tables
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M15 for spike detect; NFP (US); multi-currency calendar (NZD…SEK); broker-server DST AU/UK/US/none
why_new_for_mis: Event-tied M15 range-spike sensor that both timestamps news shocks and infers broker clock regime—calendar×realized-vol alignment.
